notes: Universe = today's S&P 1500 constituents (survivorship-biased). 'survivorship_gap' = equal-weighted universe minus RSP (equal-weighted S&P 500 ETF): an estimate of how much the universe itself is flattered.
Short interest is excluded (FINRA free files only cover listed stocks from mid-2021).
Cash in long-only modes earns 0 (T-bills not added); costs are bps by liquidity bucket on turnover.
